Harpreet Dutta
Frontend Engineer | Hinjewadi, Pune
harpreet.dutta603@example.com | +91 9384743935

Versatile frontend engineer focused on building performant, accessible web interfaces and improving developer workflows. Strong at translating designs into responsive components, optimizing load times, and collaborating with product and QA to deliver features on tight schedules. Seeking to continue shipping user-centered interfaces and mentor junior engineers.

Experience
Pixelwave Studios — Mar 2026 - Present
Frontend Engineer (Hybrid)
- Implemented a component library using TypeScript and React.js with Tailwind CSS utility classes, reducing design-to-development cycle by 35% and cutting duplicate styles across 12 product pages.
- Optimized critical CSS and code-splitting for a streaming landing experience, lowering first contentful paint by 42% and improving Lighthouse performance scores from 58 to 86.
- Led cross-team adoption of CSS conventions and Tailwind CSS migration for marketing templates, removing 18kB of unused CSS per page and stabilizing visual regressions by introducing strict linting rules.
- Introduced Git-based release tagging and automated changelog generation in CI, reducing deployment rollbacks by 50% and improving traceability for hotfixes.

Quanta Retail — Jun 2023 - Feb 2026
UI Engineer (Remote)
- Rebuilt the checkout flow with TypeScript and Next.js, integrating Tailwind CSS for responsive layouts; conversion rate improved by 12% and average cart abandonment fell by 9%.
- Converted legacy styles to a utility-first approach with Tailwind CSS and modular CSS fallbacks, decreasing page stylesheet size by 28% and accelerating developer onboarding.
- Collaborated with backend and QA to migrate client-side form validations to TypeScript types and runtime checks, reducing production form errors by 60%.
- Streamlined component documentation in Confluence and introduced Git-driven component change logs, which cut cross-team clarification requests by 40%.

Projects
Design System Starter Kit
- Created a starter kit combining React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS for rapid prototyping; included example pages, accessibility checklist, and Git workflow templates used by two internal teams.

Performance Budget Monitor
- Built a lightweight script to track bundle sizes and key performance metrics in CI; alerted on regressions and prevented three major bundle increases during sprints.

Skills
Languages: TypeScript
Frameworks/Stack: React.js, Next.js
Styling: CSS, Tailwind CSS
Tools: Git, Confluence

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
